Mutitaśrī
co-translator of Nāgārjuna's Yuktiṣaṣṭhikākārikā into Tibetan. See JASB. 1907, p. 547.

Mutitaśrījñāna
transl. of Jambhalastotra. Suzuki, Otani 4566.

Mutukkuriśśi bhāṇa
or Śṛṅgāralīlātilakabhāṇa. by Bhāskara of Mutukkuriśśi family near Shoranore. Trippūṇittura II. 146. See Kerala Skt. Lit. p. 445; also K. K. Raja, CKSL. p.. 118. 167.
Pt.. Calcutta, 1934.

Mutturāma Śāstrin
--Hālāsyanāthadaṇḍaka. Adyar I. p. 197b. ascribed wrongly to a. See Adyar D. IV. Extr. ii. p. 203.

Muttusubbakavi
father of Laksmaṇasūri (a. of Bhāratasaṅgraha).
Pt.. KSRI. Madras, 1966.
--Saṃkṣiptarāmāyaṇa. See Ind. Ant. XXXIV. 1905. p. 176.

Muttusvāmī Dīkṣita
son of Rāmasvāmin, one of the music trinities.
See M. Krishnamachariar, HCSL. Sn. 1053.
